description: This file implements a class `SysLogOuput` that logs performance metrics related to browser URL loads, including system info, process info, and launch metrics. It integrates with the performance metrics framework and telemetry system, and handles enabling/disabling logging, URL change events, load completion, and visibility changes.

classes.name: SysLogOuput
classes.description: A logger implementing performance metrics collection and telemetry reporting for web browser URL loads and system info.

classes.name: URLLoadedMetrics
classes.description: Encapsulates metrics related to URL loading, including memory, CPU load, uptime, and start/load times.

classes.name: MetricsAsJson
classes.description: JSON container for serializing performance metrics data to be sent as telemetry.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables logging by associating with the service, retrieving process info for the web process.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables logging and releases associated resources.

methods.name: Activated
methods.description: Marks the start time when logging is activated.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Logs a message upon deactivation, especially if the reason indicates failure or memory issues.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Called when a URL load finishes; logs relevant performance metrics and timing info.

methods.name: URLChange
methods.description: Handles URL change events by capturing system and process metrics.

methods.name: PageClosure
methods.description: Placeholder for handling page closure events.
